mentions.name: bldbrne-vr
mentions.description: A native VR reimagination of the game Bloodborne, with all interactions redesigned to feel physical in VR and combat retuned, aiming to feel like a native VR experience rather than a port.
mentions.source_excerpt: A reimagination of bloodborne as a native VR game. All interactions have been redesigned to feel physical in VR, and combat retuned etc. It feels less like the original and more like a native VR experience now
mentions.author: pantelisk
